title: Kong Event Gateway 1.3 adds self-service Kafka governance
summary: Kong Event Gateway 1.3 adds policy enforcement for Kafka requests, JSON/Avro record transcoding, field masking and AWS IAM connectivity for Amazon MSK. The release broadens Kong's governed event-streaming platform and strengthens its cross-sell surface, but the thesis remains at 69 because Kong disclosed no customer adoption, pricing, bookings, ARR, margin or revenue contribution.
confirmed: Kong published Event Gateway 1.3 on November 5, 2026 with a request-rule validator that can reject or record Kafka policy violations.
The release adds JSON-to-Avro and Avro-to-JSON transcoding, string-field masking, and AWS IAM authentication for Amazon MSK backends.
Kong positions the release as extending Konnect governance from APIs, LLM traffic and MCP servers to Kafka event streams.
uncertain: Kong did not disclose named customer adoption, pricing, bookings, ARR, growth, gross margin, retention, cash flow or revenue contribution for Event Gateway 1.3.
The release's commercial uptake and competitive durability remain unproven.
